Element.Name: Again
Element.Hint: Again action is used to execute a block number of times in a loop. It returns to execute from the start of the current block. If a rule expression is used, it returns to execute from the start of the current block while the rule expression evaluates to true. When the rule expression evaluates to false, the program continue to the next statement.

Element.Name: ExecBlock
Element.Hint: Execute specific block and return to the next statement. When a rule expression is used, it executes the TrueBlock when rule expression evaluates to true and the FalseBlock when rule expression evaluates to false.

Attribute.Name: TrueBlock
Attribute.Hint: Block to be executed when Rule is true (or empty)

Attribute.Name: FalseBlock
Attribute.Hint: Block to be executed when Rule is false

Element.Name: ExecExit
Element.Hint: Execute a specific block and exit from the current block. When a rule expression is used, it executes the TrueBlock and exit from the current block when rule expression evaluates to true

Attribute.Name: TrueBlock
Attribute.Hint: Block to be executed when Rule is true (or empty)

Attribute.Name: FalseBlock
Attribute.Hint: Block to be executed when Rule is false

Element.Name: ExitBlock
Element.Hint: Exit from the current block. If a rule expression is used, it exit the current block when the rule expression evaluates to true.

Element.Name: ExitProgram
Element.Hint: The ExitProgram action terminates MagicData.

Element.Name: ExitFile
Element.Hint: Quit current input file processing and moves the input file to the Error directory. 'Error' Directory must be located in the defined Input directory. This action is usually used when input file is not valid. If a rule expression is used, it quit current input file processing and moves file when the rule expression evaluates to true.

Element.Name: Switch
Element.Hint: The Switch statement is a control statement that handles multiple cases by executing the case-block whose case-value matches value. The switch statement can include any number of cases, but no two cases within the same switch statement can have the same value.

Attribute.Name: Value
Attribute.Hint: Reference to String, long or int field which contain the value to compare to the Cases

Attribute.Name: Cases
Attribute.Hint: The cases are written in case-value, case-block pairs separated by comma. The `Default' case-value can be used to execute a block when no specific case-value was matched. case-value can be numeric constant, string constant or a field. `Default' case is optional but must be the last case.

Attribute.Name: Code

(Field type - string) ResourceRecordCount - get current resource record count. (Field type - int) RecordStartPosition - get the record start position from the beginning of the file according to the resource. (Field type - int) RecordEndPosition - get the record end position from the beginning of the file according to the resource. (Field type - int) StartProcess - get the current resource processing start time. (Field type - string) EndProcess - get the current resource processing end time.
